name: Armorskin Robes of Fire

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text:
This +1 resilient explorer's clothing is woven with thread spun by an elemental, and it sparkles with radiant color. The thread is hot as fire. You gain resistance 5 to fire damage.

Activate—Elemental Sheath 1 (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

---
Effect The elemental threads cover your skin, further protecting you but limiting mobility. For 10 minutes, you gain resistance 5 to slashing and piercing damage but take a –5-foot status penalty to all Speeds. While activated, any creature that touches you or damages you with an unarmed attack or melee weapon without the reach trait takes 1d6 fire damage.
